en.value: science fiction with emphasis on scientific or technical detail, or on scientific accuracy

value.text: Hard science fiction is sci-fi that is grounded in reality, where attention to scientific accuracy, technology, and plausibility shapes the outcome of the story.

Hard science fiction is a subgenre of science fiction that emphasizes scientific accuracy, logic, and technical detail with a distinct focus on the "harder" sciences: astronomy, biology, physics, chemistry, engineering, etc. It's sci-fi that *might* be possible in the near or far future (or that may have occurred in the past), given the right resources, technologies, or time to make it happen.
